deathBeat: d8: 🕯️ Vincent Kamara is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
recoverHome: d9: That night, they bring Vincent home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
systemVoice: d8: SYSTEM: "Perimeter violated! This is unprecedented! ...Is this unprecedented? Checking. Yes. Unprecedented."
d8: SYSTEM: "INTRUDER REPELLED. The pantry’s aroma is now classified as a defensive liability. The audience is chanting the defenders’ names. Fan clubs are forming. This is how it starts."

d8: ◈ THE SPARK — something clicks. A trick Wael learned long ago suddenly has edges it never had. SYSTEM: "ANOMALY: organic unit demonstrates pattern recognition. Slot capacity increased. We are taking notes." (Ability slots: 2)

d8: ◈ SYSTEM: "RATINGS DIP. The audience wants STAKES — pointed ones. A PALISADE. Stockpile 14,000 kcal, 350 wood and 60 stone. Walls make such good television. You will thank us when the teeth come."
d10: SYSTEM: Naming things. Very human. The audience approves.
d10: ⬢ SYSTEM: "Neural depth 35. I can hold more of you now — ability slots: 3."
d10: SYSTEM: Identification complete. You are 0.3% less lost.
